en: A colorized panoramic view of a small European town in a valley, framed by fields and low hills. In the foreground is a river with a bridge and tree‑lined banks; behind it stands a church with a tall white tower and spire surrounded by red‑roofed houses and a few factory chimneys. The style is that of an early 20th‑century lithographic postcard with printed red text at the top and side margins.
